_comment: Routes the edge registers that neither docs/openapi.yaml nor docs/openapi-internal.yaml describes, each with the reason. A new route must be documented in one of those files or added here with a reason; an entry that becomes documented or stops existing must be removed (scripts/tests/openapi-route-coverage.test.mjs).
route_registrations_note: Re-pinned by D-B3-openapi-sdk (D2-003) from 86 to 108: the W2 .route(...) registrations are documented or allowlisted; three internal routes were added and six documented routes removed from the allowlist. OPENAPI-INTERNAL (decision 3.13): the eight /v1/internal/* routes are documented in docs/openapi-internal.yaml and left this list; the count is unchanged. W5-S4 (F-t2-068): POST /v1/profiles/:id/clear-data is documented in docs/openapi.yaml and re-pinned from 120 to 121. Q3-E3.7.6-B-edge: POST /v1/internal/queues/{queue_name}/seen is documented in docs/openapi-internal.yaml. The scan counted 129 registrations at HEAD against the 121 pin; the pin is set to the count with this route, 130 (ROUTE_BASELINE_UPDATE=1 writes the same number). Q4-E4.1-6c: PUT /v1/sources/:id/definition is registered (GET /v1/sources/:id rides the existing :id route), re-pinned 130 to 131; the route is documented by Q4-E4.1-6e. Q4-E4.7-B8a: the recount of the production .route(...) registrations in routes.rs, fleet_routes.rs, queue_routes.rs and agent_routes/*.rs is 131, equal to the pin (a count of 126 is the number of distinct normalised paths, not of registrations). The five routes documented by Q4-E4.7-B8a (GET .../hit-test, POST .../attach-current-tab, POST .../tabs/{tab_id}/mark, POST /v1/audit/page, POST /v1/browser/redirect-hop) are in docs/openapi.yaml and need no entry here. Q4-E4.7-B8c: POST /v1/audio, POST /v1/search/images, POST /v1/search/videos, POST /v1/search/similar and POST /v1/search/suggest are documented in docs/openapi.yaml and removed from this list; the registration count is unchanged. Q2-WS15.S3a: GET /v1/schedules/:id/requests/:rid and GET /v1/schedules/:id/runs are registered beside trigger and backfill and documented in docs/openapi.yaml, re-pinned 131 to 133.
